purpose: Single source of truth for the Nabaperks print poster registry, copy, format metadata, and layout anatomy. Intended for app runtime and external analysis of the full poster system.

collections.name: A4 counter posters
collections.description: Portrait designs for tills, counters, windows and wall frames.

shared.reassurance: 18+ to redeem · One visit stamp here per UK date · Rewards redeem from the next weekday · Terms apply

friction.browser: No app — opens in your browser

placeholders.stamps: Validated venue stampsRequired as a base-10 integer string.
placeholders.StampsWord: The same 1–6 stampsRequired value via shared.numberWords, first letter capitalised.

shared.placeholderPolicy: Resolve recursively in every customer-copy string before render; reject unknown or unresolved brace tokens. Customer-specific progress is not a supported poster placeholder.
shared.rolloutPolicy: Every registered template renders on direct request and in the dev preview. Merchant pickers and the poster email bundle expose production templates only; review and experimental templates stay registered without a silent fallback.
shared.typeTierPolicy: Substantive snaps to one of three family steps: 12 (mono structural rows), 14 (ledger body), 16 (panel ledes). Hook stays a per-design display scale inside the shared band; facts is 9 across the kit.

qr.measurement: complete light box including quiet zone
qr.productionRule: Record actual QR version and ECC; preserve square modules; test the final print on representative phones.
